nodes.question: What is the number of public toilets per 10,000 people in China by the end of 2021?
nodes.answer: There are only 3.29 public toilets per 10,000 people in China by the end of 2021.

nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the role of independent public toilets in modern cities?
nodes.answer: Independent public toilets serve as critical infrastructure for daily life and tourism, especially in densely populated areas lacking municipal pipeline connections.
